summary.name: Adapter
summary.one_liner: Adapter is a free Mac and Windows app for converting images, audio and video, with a graphical interface built on FFmpeg and VLC previews.
summary.what_it_does: Adapter is a graphical front end for FFmpeg that converts video, audio and image files on Mac and Windows. Users drop files into a queue, pick an output format from a pop-up, and run batch conversions. Two side-by-side VLC players let users preview conversion output against the original, and the app estimates the output file size before converting. Batch image options include setting a common height, converting TIFF to JPG, and adding watermarks. A trim feature cuts audio or video to a chosen duration and exports it in a chosen format.
notable: FFmpeg back-end with side-by-side VLC previews of input and output
Estimates output file size before conversion
Simple default mode with advanced panels that can be toggled
Installer advertised as free of toolbars and bundled extras
caveats: Page describes it as freeware but does not name a license or open-source status
Page does not state specific supported formats or system requirements
